header: Where the figures above come from
text: Use it with any other data element. Editors type every figure, and this note says what it is based on: period, population, method and source.
note: Say who maintains the figures and how corrections are made. If you never mention revisions, readers assume there were none.

rows.title: Period
rows.text: Not the publication date; the two are rarely the same.

rows.title: Sample
rows.text: A percentage means little without the total it refers to.
